verdict.rationale: Morph is an API platform that holds user artifacts such as custom-trained Reflex classifiers and request data, so data export is a fair question for it. The evidence shows OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints that keep switching costs low, and a guide for migrating onto Morph, but nothing documents exporting user data or trained models in open formats. API compatibility is an adjacent portability trait, not a documented export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
